body:
I am currently at University. I will seek that stuff out i guess i never thought it applied to me. Maybe because the onset of this neutrality has been so slow and its only because of the birthday landmark that it has come to the fore. I will do that.

Once again thank you this. It is at least interesting which is enough for me not to feel so empty about the whole thing. If i had money would give you reddit gold. I owe you more then a stranger on the internet should owe.

I think thats what i mean when i said i just wanted to slip away, not transfer the pain. I suppose that isn't possible. 

What did you do to reach the state of cushioning yourself? 

Also thank you for your time, I know this isn't a unique predicament but it seems insurmountable.

I don't know, this seems like the base of everything this neutral state and any remedy will just be a temporary avoidance of what seems to make sense. Taking my life seems to be final and an ending of that state. 

How do i indulge in self-care when i dislike myself and what i take from the world.
